function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

Here’s a quick guide to the most common men’s underwear styles, what they’re best suited for, and key features to look for when choosing the right pair for you. | Style | Typical Cut & Support | Best For | Key Features to Look For | |-------|----------------------|----------|--------------------------| | **Briefs** (classic, high‑cut) | Full coverage, waistband sits at the natural waist, offers good support for active use | Everyday wear, gym, running, cycling | • Elastic waistband with a smooth seam
• Breathable fabric (cotton, modal)
• Seamless or flat‑lock seams to reduce chafing | | **Boxer Briefs** (mid‑rise, longer leg) | Combines the support of briefs with the length of boxers; often has a snug fit | Daily wear, travel, moderate activity | • Stretchy material (spandex blend)
• Moisture‑wicking properties for hot climates
• Reinforced stitching for durability | | **Boxers** (loose, long leg) | Loose fit, waistband sits at the natural waist or slightly higher | Casual lounging, sleepwear, light walking | • Lightweight fabrics (cotton, bamboo)
• Soft, breathable weave
• Minimal seams to avoid irritation | | **Trunks** (shorter leg than boxer briefs) | Similar to boxer briefs but with a shorter leg; offers a modern, streamlined look | Fashion‑forward style, beachwear, moderate activity | • Tapered leg for a sleek silhouette
• Good moisture control if made from performance blends | | **Thongs / G-strings** (minimal rear coverage) | Minimal coverage, no back panel | Swimwear, tight clothing where visible panty lines are a concern | • Ultra‑thin, breathable fabric
• Secure waistband to prevent slipping | | **Compression Shorts** (tight, supportive) | Very snug fit, often with a built‑in brief or liner | Sports, running, cycling, post‑workout recovery | • High‑density spandex for compression benefits
• Ventilation panels for airflow | | **Performance / Technical** (moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor) | Usually boxer briefs or trunks with engineered fabrics | Athletes, hot climates, long travel | • Advanced moisture‑wicking fibers (polyester, nylon blends)
• Anti‑odor treatment (silver ions, antimicrobial coating) | ### How to Pick the Right Pair 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - *Low activity* (e.g., office work): Boxers or loose briefs for breathability. - *Moderate activity* (walking, light exercise): Boxer briefs or trunks with moisture‑wicking fabric. - *High activity* (running, cycling, sports): Compression shorts or performance boxer briefs with reinforced stitching and ventilation. 2. **Fit Matters** - **Waistband**: Should sit comfortably at your natural waist without digging into skin. Look for a wide, padded waistband for extra comfort. - **Leg Length**: Mid‑rise or low‑rise depends on your preference and the type of pants you’ll wear. Low‑rise can be more comfortable under tight jeans. - **Seam Placement**: Flat‑lock or seamless seams reduce friction and are ideal for preventing chafing during long periods of sitting or movement. 3. **Fabric Choice** - **Cotton**: Soft, breathable, great for everyday wear. However, it can retain moisture and may not dry quickly. - **Modal / Bamboo**: Soft, moisture‑absorbent, and eco‑friendly options that feel luxurious. - **Performance Blends**: Polyester, nylon, or spandex blends wick moisture away and dry fast—ideal for sweaty conditions. - **Hybrid Fabrics**: Some brands combine cotton with a small percentage of elastane for stretch and shape retention. 4. **Special Features** - **Anti‑Chafing**: Look for flat‑lock seams or a “no‑seam” design if you’re prone to irritation. - **Odor Control**: Silver‑ion or antimicrobial treatments help keep you fresh during extended wear. - **Eco‑Friendly Options**: Recycled polyester or organic cotton reduces environmental impact. 5. **Try Them On** - If possible, try on a few pairs in-store or order from retailers with a generous return policy. Pay attention to how the waistband feels after a few hours of wear. ### Quick Style Cheat Sheet | Situation | Recommended Style | Why It Works | |-----------|-------------------|--------------| | **Office / Formal** | Classic briefs or boxer briefs | Provides support and a clean line under dress pants. | | **Beach / Swim** | Trunks or thongs | Keeps you dry and prevents visible panty lines. | | **Travel / Long Flights** | Compression shorts or performance boxer briefs | Reduces swelling and keeps you comfortable during long periods of sitting. | | **Hot Climate** | Performance boxer briefs or lightweight boxers | Breathable fabrics keep you cool and dry. | | **Fashion Statement** | Trendy trunks or designer briefs | Adds a stylish touch to casual outfits. | --- #### Bottom Line - **For everyday comfort**: Go with a well‑fitted boxer brief or classic brief made from breathable cotton or a cotton‑blend. - **For active or hot days**: Choose a performance blend with moisture‑wicking technology. - **For special occasions or travel**: Opt for a supportive, low‑profile pair that stays in place and doesn’t show through clothing. Feel free to let me know if you’d like specific product recommendations or if you have any particular concerns (e.g., sensitive skin, allergies).
